part: 2a of 5 — rules/rulings in non-apply scripts (first half)
read: see scripts-1.json `read` — same material; no sources re-read for this part

entries.statement: OVERRIDE_CHAINS: 26 explicit AniList chains the relation walker cannot derive; 10 carry `ruledExtent` (Kingdom/Beastars/Black Butler class) and are standing candidates re-asserted on every run; extras are order-only in-flow components (Kizumonogatari inside Monogatari, MHA 170+1/170+1.5, Golden Kamuy OVAs, Slime films, Arslan OVA, Magus Bride OVA, Black Butler Murder/Atlantic, To-Love-Ru Darkness specials).
entries.notes: Keys are AFL slugs, not series ids. Reasons inline only on the ruledExtent entries + some comments (JoJo Off & Monster absent by design; Sealed Card excluded; Sapporo Beer recut excluded; 1991 Arslan OVA excluded).

entries.statement: Stitch candidacy: an open count_mismatch flag where AFL classified MORE than the matched entry aired by >2 is the lumped-page signature (AFL cannot know more episodes than exist); AFL having FEWER is site lag and never a stitch trigger.
entries.notes: Tokyo Ghoul slipped a former +12 gate (S1+√A page vs the √A entry was exactly 12 over).

entries.statement: Stitch finalize gate: an un-ruled chain auto-finalizes only when the chain's aired sum matches AFL's continuous numbering within ±2 OR the excess fits inside the last (airing) node (lag); a RULED extension only needs the chain to COVER AFL's numbering (chainAired >= aflMax − 2) — the ruling covers the excess. Ambiguity or gate failure files count_mismatch (stage: stitch) and never guesses.
entries.notes: The same ±2/lag gate is copied into afg-extend.ts, afg-expansion.ts and reconcile-structure.ts — four call sites, not a lib predicate.

entries.statement: A ruled extension is structure only: the canonical id and title an existing series already carries are stable (a re-stitch never re-keys or renames it).
entries.notes: Un-ruled stitches CAN re-key (old.id !== series.id → delete old row) — the stability rule applies only to ruled extensions / extend / reconcile.

entries.statement: AFL-range merge: on re-stitch only AFL's own numbering range is rewritten (delete rows ≤ aflTop, reinsert); rows beyond it (AFG/Wikipedia fills on a ruled extension) survive.
entries.notes: Header cites '§10 AFL-range merge rule'.

entries.statement: Every episode writer goes through filterEpisodeRows (community caps + type overrides) — a re-stitch, extension fill, expansion or wiki row-creation must never resurrect rows or types a ruling removed.
entries.notes: Outcome check in audit-ui-truth ruling_violation (caps + type overrides).

entries.statement: Ownership guard: an un-ruled chain walk stops at any AniList entry another canonical series already claims (ruled splits stay split).
entries.notes: Predicate lives in lib/chain (lib home); scripts are the call sites.

entries.statement: Movies/OVAs inside a chain count only when numbered by the community; otherwise they are order-only watch-order entries (extras with a null span).
entries.notes: Header comment cites '§10'.

entries.statement: One candidate's failure (e.g. AniList outage on a cache miss) must never kill a stitch/extend/reconcile run — it stays flagged and retries next time (per-candidate try/catch).

RULED_SPLITS: AFG pages whose numbering deliberately runs across one of OUR ruled splits are skipped by afg-extend by name — bleach (367+ = TYBW) and tokyo-ghoul (25+ = :re, the Naruto/Shippuden pattern).
entries.notes: Comment: the ownership guard would stop the walk anyway; the skip list keeps the report honest about WHY.

entries.statement: AFG-driven extension: the AniList chain must INDEPENDENTLY confirm AFG's numbering (walkChain + the ±2/lag gate) before anything applies; unconfirmed pages flag count_mismatch (stage: extend); a chain that would SHRINK us is skipped.
entries.notes: 'populate what AFG/AFL know, always via repeatable mechanisms' (Sean 2026-08-24).

entries.statement: Extend candidacy compares AFG's max against the series' STRUCTURE (component ends / totals / aired), not the episodes table; extend only when AFG's numbering outruns the structure by >2 — our own episodes exceeding it is the ruled AFL-extras class (Angel Beats OVAs, Kenshin 95-100), already accepted per case; walking chains to 'explain' extras grabs unrelated OVAs. Sparse pages (<6 rows) carry no signal.
bundle_parts: candidacy vs structure not episode count (Cuckoos 36 vs total 24)
ruled AFL-extras class never triggers a walk

entries.statement: Episode MERGE on extension: existing AFL rows stay the type authority and are untouched; AFG fills only the numbers we lack, with AFG's own 3-way taxonomy and null air_date.
entries.notes: AFG vocabulary: red=filler, blue=mixed, plain=canon; no anime-canon.

entries.statement: relations.ts RULED: 27 franchise relation pairs (afl_slug from → to → kind) whose kind overrides the AniList auto edge per pair — sequel/remake/spin_off/alternative/side_story; 'remake' is not an AniList concept.
entries.notes: Source of truth stated as docs/franchise-rulings.md; only 2 of 27 rows carry an inline reason. Pairs missing from canonical are skipped silently (recovery-dependent).

entries.statement: series_relations keeps AniList's full relation vocabulary verbatim lowercase (SEQUEL/PREQUEL/SIDE_STORY/SPIN_OFF/ALTERNATIVE/PARENT) between components of DIFFERENT canonical series; the table is rebuilt from scratch each run and RULED pairs replace the auto rows for that pair.

stabilize.ts DUPLICATE_OF: five per-season AFL pages ruled duplicates of a stitched series (food-wars plates ×4 → food-wars; nekomonogatari-kuro → monogatari-series) — series row deleted, source_map disposition 'duplicate'.
entries.notes: Persists as a source_map disposition (backfill.ts honors it); the map itself is history.

entries.statement: stabilize.ts SPARSE_HOLD: eight AFL pages AFL never fully classified (Kinnikuman 4/137…) removed from canonical until classification reaches 60% (the resolver's sparse guard) — kakegurui, city-hunter, elemental-gelade, kinnikuman, ranking-kings, mobile-suit-zeta-gundam, mobile-suit-gundam-zz, digimon-adventure-02.
entries.notes: Several of these later re-entered via canon-tier.ts / canon-tier-2.ts (ranking-kings, kinnikuman, city-hunter, elemental-gelade) — the hold list is stale as a list; the 60% predicate lives in lib/resolve.

entries.statement: School Days / School Rumble disentanglement: the corrupt-era alias matched School Days to School Rumble; the School Rumble shell is deleted, school-days is manually matched to AniList 2476 and re-resolved; School Rumble has no readable AFL page (§9).

merge.ts MERGES: sword-art-online absorbs sword-art-online-alicization — Alicization = seasons 3+ of the one SAO series (franchise-rulings.md); absorbed rows renumber by afl_offset, components append in season_order.
entries.notes: Applied; re-runs skip (victim absent). Header mentions 'later the recovered Food Wars plates' but those went via stabilize DUPLICATE_OF, not MERGES.

entries.statement: Multi-page merge aggregates: aired sums; total sums only when both known else null; victim's status/end_date/next_airing win (currency); popularity max; average_score base-first.
entries.notes: Parallel aggregation rule lives in lib/chain aggregate (lib home) — potential drift.

entries.statement: polish-ids.ts REKEY: nine canonical id re-keys before ids became user-visible (jojo-s… → jojos-bizarre-adventure, heaven-s… → heavens-lost-property, hell-s… → hells-paradise, miss-kobayashi-s… → miss-kobayashis-dragon-maid, konosuba…, pretty-guardian-sailor-moon-crystal-seasons-1-2 → sailor-moon-crystal, the-melancholy-of-haruhi-suzumiya-2009 → …-suzumiya, initial-d-1st-stage → initial-d, x-tv → x).
entries.notes: No per-entry reasons. Architecture fact in header: no ON UPDATE CASCADE, so a re-key is copy → move children → delete.

entries.statement: ingest_fractionals is the staging/ruling record (service-role only); watch_order_entries is the canonical app-readable mirror of its order_only rows, rebuilt idempotently (entries whose fractional vanished are dropped).

display_label on a watch-order entry is a per-series SURFACE RULING held in the code map (RULED_LABELS); an entry absent from the map carries display_label null and does NOT render — everything stays data-ready and unsurfaced until its own ruling.
entries.notes: MHA labels PARKED 2026-08-24 (map emptied) pending the specials/OVAs/movies STATUS design pass.

entries.statement: PARKED v2 watch-order logic (reference point): +N entries render as episode rows (#170+1, #170+1.5), COUNT as units — section envelope includes their chapters and volume, section counts include them, they appear on the manga strip, are selectable/steppable, and the series total reads '170+1.5'. Re-activate by restoring 'my-hero-academia': { 171: '170+1', 171.5: '170+1.5' }.
entries.notes: Text says 'docs §10 has the full version'.

entries.statement: sync-watch-order RULED_RECORDS: my-hero-academia positions 171 (ch 431, vol 42, kind special) and 171.5 (ch 431.5, vol 42, kind special) carry structured adaptation fields.
entries.notes: Duplicates facts also stored in ingest_fractionals notes by apply-rulings-20260824.ts (prose there, structured here).

entries.statement: audit-titles MANUAL_EXCLUDE: berserk-golden-age-arc, kizumonogatari, digimon-adventure-tri (film trilogies/series — movies out of v1 scope, Sean 2026-08-22, re-evaluate with watch-order) and one-pace (fan re-edit, not official — excluded pending Sean confirmation).
entries.notes: one-pace is marked 'pending Sean confirmation' — an unresolved ruling in a standing map. Kizumonogatari later became order-only extras inside monogatari-series (stitch OVERRIDE_CHAINS) — the exclusion note and the extras entry describe the same films.

entries.statement: AFL alias corruption re-audit: a staged page whose served title disagrees (titlesAgree) with the index title for its slug is an alias-corruption victim — purge staging + canonical, exclude in source_map with a note so sweeps skip it until a deliberate re-audit.
entries.notes: audit-titles reads the FIXTURE index (fixtures/afl-shows-index.html), not a live one.

entries.statement: Wikipedia episode fill is FILL-ONLY: AFL remains the title authority where it has real titles; Wikipedia fills '' titles and null air dates; a wiki title that disagrees with a non-empty stored title is NOT written (counted as a conflict; >3 conflicts per series files taxonomy_conflict 'numbering offset suspected').

Wiki fill gates: only numbers 1..aired are written; rows this script CREATES go through filterEpisodeRows and default to type canon (row-less canon-tier series get full rows); the page family's max number must fit our aired count (+2 lag) or the family flags instead of writing garbage.
bundle_parts: created rows via filterEpisodeRows, type canon

entries.statement: NUMBERING-SPACE TRANSLATION (the Dr. Stone Ryuusui lesson): every per-episode external source has its OWN numbering space; a series with a MID-RUN order-only component REQUIRES a declared shift (WIKI_NUMBERING_SHIFTS) or proven alignment (fractional separators, or page top == our count) before any fill past that position — otherwise fills past the insert are withheld and count_mismatch flags; declared shifts also run in CORRECTION mode (a stored title matching the wiki value at the WRONG offset is rewritten).
bundle_parts: mid-run order-only requires declared shift or alignment evidence
page top == our count proves alignment (Magus Bride S2 case)
entries.notes: Dr. Stone itself resolved differently — Wikipedia labels Ryuusui 35.5 (already our space); the shifted source was AFL, handled by lib SOURCE_NUMBERING_SHIFTS. WIKI_NUMBERING_SHIFTS is therefore EMPTY and duplicates the lib mechanism's purpose for a source that never needed it.

entries.statement: EVIDENCE-LOCKED per-page offsets (Sean's When They Cry case): a wiki page's offset into OUR numbering must be PROVEN before its rows merge — votes from exact air-date matches (weight 2) and ≥75% title-token similarity (weight 1) against stored rows; the winner needs ≥3 votes AND ≥3× the runner-up (margin lock); else component lock (page named 'season N' → our season-N component group, labels first then position), else first-segment fallback (exact-name/own-article page starting at 1, dates within ±1 year), else continuity lock (rows begin exactly where merged rows end, fit our count, dates monotone); unlockable pages skip per page.
entries.alias: When They Cry case / Kingdom S6 lesson / Slime lesson
bundle_parts: component lock by season label, positional fallback
first-segment fallback needs page-name match + datesCompatible

entries.statement: Wikipedia list-page search can return NAMESAKES and token-overlapping strangers ('List of Kingdom episodes' is the 2007 British drama; Orphan Black / HBO Girls; all four 'Rurouni Kenshin' list pages belong to the 1996 series) — evidence-locked pages prove identity by content, fallback pages must prove it by NAME, and a page whose earliest air date sits >1 year from our start is another show whatever its name says; main-article fallback tries disambiguated forms first ('(Japanese TV series)').
entries.alias: the Kingdom lesson / Orphan-Black lesson / SHY class
entries.notes: Source trap — belongs in the research-agent definition too.

entries.statement: Every Wikipedia fractional episode row (35.5-style) is staged durably into ingest_fractionals (Sean's ruling: non-main entries are NOTED so the UI/watch-order phase decides from data).

audit-afg-structure RULED: 'bishoujo-senshi-sailor-moon' → sailor-moon (90s original, NOT Crystal — synonym collision) and 'digimon-adventure' → digimon-digital-monsters (zero-episode AFG stub colliding with the 2020 entry's id; AFG's title is the 1999 romaji).
entries.notes: null value = ruled NOT a match (shape supports it; no such entry yet).

entries.statement: AFG identity match tiers (identity-first, flag-first): registry → ruled → slug (AFG slug equals our id / afl_slug / slugified title) → title (whitespace-insensitive FULL title/synonym equality) → prefix (subtitle-stripped, ≥5 chars) which registers only when the episode span INDEPENDENTLY agrees (±2 of our max or a component boundary); a key two series both claim is ambiguous and never auto-matches; one afg id per series (strongest tier wins, never overwrites an existing registration).
entries.notes: Header: 'AFG's series structuring is thoughtfully curated — consult it as evidence even where AFL exists'.

entries.statement: audit-ui-truth REVIEWED_NUMBERED_SPECIALS: 29 (series:anilistId) non-season components verified as community-counted in the numbered run (Queue-2 Groups A/B, Sean sign-off 2026-08-23; Clear Card Prologue OVA = ep 71 and shounan-junai-gumi 1-5 identity, Sean 2026-08-24; dr-stone Ryuusui confirmed order-only mid-run).
entries.notes: A ruling map living inside an AUDIT file (suppression-with-reason). fist-of-the-blue-sky:3864 is still listed as 'AFL numbers 23-26' although apply-rulings-20260825b demoted that component to order-only — stale entry. Group B entries flagged 'medium (re-open if evidence emerges)'.

entries.statement: Any non-typical entry (special/OVA/movie/recap) NUMBERED into a run by any source is a research trigger — verify against community consensus, ask Sean, then record the ruling in REVIEWED_NUMBERED_SPECIALS.
